Definition: Beth-Dagon, the name of two places in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Beth-Dagon means "house of Dagon." The name is shared by several bearers: The temple of Dagon in Judah; The temple of Dagon in Asher. It turns up in Joshua 15:41 and Joshua 19:27.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Beth-Dagon is worth knowing, because God's people actually walked there.
